causality_tests.failure_condition: Any prefix score or target changes.
causality_tests.name: future_append_corruption_truncation
causality_tests.procedure: Append, corrupt, and remove rows strictly after decision time minus 8h and compare exact scores and targets.

causality_tests.failure_condition: Organizer-equivalent UTC encodings produce different observations.
causality_tests.name: timestamp_storage_equivalence
causality_tests.procedure: Compare aware, timezone-naive UTC, and integer epoch close-time representations.

causality_tests.failure_condition: Input order changes score bytes, membership, or targets.
causality_tests.name: deterministic_order
causality_tests.procedure: Reverse symbol order and price-row order under seed 20260801.

causality_tests.failure_condition: A score reads or serializes an outcome label.
causality_tests.name: label_free_a5_boundary
causality_tests.procedure: Inject opaque outcome-like auxiliary values and require identical exact score dictionaries.

decision_contract.insufficient_scheduled: empty mapping after exactly one score_boundary({}) call
decision_contract.off_grid: empty mapping with no score_boundary call
decision_contract.rebalance_rule: nonnegative integer 8h epoch index modulo 6 equals zero

derived_features.availability: 69 contiguous eight-hour returns from 70 unique positive closes through the lagged cutoff
derived_features.missing_rule: Exclude symbol for insufficient history, duplicate valid close time, nonpositive or nonfinite close, gap, sigma below 1e-6, or latest close more than 16h stale.

derived_features.availability: seven three-day blocks from the established path
derived_features.formula: C=clip(2*fraction(block sign agrees with established sign)-1,0,1)
derived_features.missing_rule: C=0 when the absolute established-path sum is at most 1e-12; otherwise inherit feature exclusion.

derived_features.availability: at least 20 complete current pure-crypto symbols
derived_features.missing_rule: Flat if fewer than 20 complete symbols or any rank is invalid.

derived_features.availability: finite final scores at a scheduled boundary
derived_features.formula: K=max(6,floor(N/4)); top K long, bottom K short; equal 0.25 side budgets and 0.03 cap
derived_features.missing_rule: Flat if every selected long is not strictly positive, every selected short is not strictly negative, or any sleeve, cap, gross, or net invariant fails.

forbidden_inputs: stablecoins, metals, commodities, indexes, equities, or other TradFi proxies
funding, mark price, OHLC shape, volume, order flow, or order book
organizer regime, common-market direction, position, fill, fee, equity, drawdown, or PnL
forward label or outcome passed through context auxiliary
private/final observations, V1 results, other teams, ballots, or leaderboards

raw_inputs.coverage: organizer-streamed eight-hour transaction bars for current A6-certified eligible symbols
raw_inputs.missing_rule: No fill or interpolation; use only the latest contiguous causal suffix.

raw_inputs.availability_timestamp: current decision after organizer pure-crypto reconstitution
raw_inputs.coverage: A6-certified native-crypto universe intersected with executable symbols
raw_inputs.missing_rule: Never synthesize membership or add Binance-listed non-crypto proxies.

score_evidence_contract.aggregate: one ordinary Pearson correlation across the union of six disjoint retained fold pools
score_evidence_contract.endpoint_rule: Require exactly one finite positive organizer executable open for each emitted symbol at t and t+48h.
score_evidence_contract.fold_assignment: Assign a pair only when t and t+48h both lie inside the same development fold; purge boundary crossings.
score_evidence_contract.fold_statistic: ordinary Pearson across every retained decision-symbol pair without label ranking, timestamp demeaning, timestamp-level averaging, weighting, or Fisher transform
score_evidence_contract.label: simple executable-open(t)-to-executable-open(t+48h) return
score_evidence_contract.neighbor_staging: Do not observe any neighbor, ablation, or risk arm until the exact no-control reference clears every core and A5 pre-neighbor gate.
score_evidence_contract.required: pooled IC>0, at least four of six fold ICs>0, every pair and decision minimum, complete scheduled score-row coverage after warmup, and independent semantic-coupling approval
